summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly open-market share repurchases under an existing buyback program announced on 16 February 2026. The issuer purchased a total of 2,168,084 ordinary shares from UBS AG, London Branch, across LSE, CHIX, and BATE venues at volume-weighted average prices from 590.32 GBp to 595.84 GBp. The repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing share count. Following settlement, NWG will hold 181,817,840 treasury shares and 7,970,253,980 outstanding shares. This is a routine capital return program with no tender or premium. Watch for continued execution under the buyback mandate and potential impact on EPS.
